description: This file defines the AssetService interface for managing assets within the Thingsboard platform, including methods for CRUD operations, associations with customers and edges, and querying assets.

classes.name: AssetService
classes.description: Interface for asset management operations, including CRUD, assignment, unassignment, and querying assets.

methods.name: findAssetInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves AssetInfo by tenant and asset IDs.

methods.name: findAssetById
methods.description: Retrieves Asset by tenant and asset IDs.

methods.name: findAssetByIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves Asset by tenant and asset IDs.

methods.name: findAssetByTenantIdAndName
methods.description: Finds an asset by tenant ID and asset name.

methods.name: findAssetByTenantIdAndNameAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds an asset by tenant ID and name.

methods.name: saveAsset
methods.description: Saves an asset with optional validation and conflict strategy.

methods.name: assignAssetToCustomer
methods.description: Associates an asset with a customer.

methods.name: unassignAssetFromCustomer
methods.description: Removes the association between an asset and a customer.

methods.name: deleteAsset
methods.description: Deletes an asset by tenant and asset IDs.

methods.name: findAssetsByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves assets for a tenant with pagination.

methods.name: findAssetInfosByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves asset info for a tenant with pagination.

methods.name: findAssetsByTenantIdAndType
methods.description: Finds assets by tenant ID and type.

methods.name: findAssetInfosByTenantIdAndType
methods.description: Finds asset info by tenant ID and type.

methods.name: findAssetInfosByTenantIdAndAssetProfileId
methods.description: Finds asset info by tenant ID and asset profile ID.

methods.name: findProfileEntityIdInfos
methods.description: Retrieves profile entity ID info with pagination.

methods.name: findProfileEntityIdInfosByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves profile entity ID info for a tenant.

methods.name: findAssetIdsByTenantIdAndAssetProfileId
methods.description: Finds asset IDs by tenant ID and asset profile ID.

methods.name: findAssetsByTenantIdAndIdsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds assets by tenant ID and list of asset IDs.

methods.name: deleteAssetsByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes all assets for a tenant.

methods.name: findAssetsByTenantIdAndCustomerId
methods.description: Finds assets associated with a customer.

methods.name: findAssetInfosByTenantIdAndCustomerId
methods.description: Finds asset info associated with a customer.

methods.name: findAssetsByTenantIdAndCustomerIdAndType
methods.description: Finds assets by tenant, customer, and type.

methods.name: findAssetInfosByTenantIdAndCustomerIdAndType
methods.description: Finds asset info by tenant, customer, and type.

methods.name: findAssetInfosByTenantIdAndCustomerIdAndAssetProfileId
methods.description: Finds asset info by tenant, customer, and asset profile ID.

methods.name: findAssetsByTenantIdCustomerIdAndIdsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds assets by tenant, customer, and list of asset IDs.

methods.name: unassignCustomerAssets
methods.description: Unassigns all assets from a customer.

methods.name: findAssetsByQuery
methods.description: Finds assets based on a search query.

methods.name: findAssetTypesByTenantId
methods.description: Deprecated method to find asset types by tenant ID.

methods.name: assignAssetToEdge
methods.description: Associates an asset with an edge.

methods.name: unassignAssetFromEdge
methods.description: Removes association of an asset from an edge.

methods.name: findAssetsByTenantIdAndEdgeId
methods.description: Finds assets associated with an edge.

methods.name: findAssetsByTenantIdAndEdgeIdAndType
methods.description: Finds assets associated with an edge filtered by type.
